name: peak_torque_vs_yang_2013
detail: published FEA of the same motor (Yang, Krishnamurthy & Brown, IEEE IEMDC 2013): another group and code, not a measurement; tolerance 5 % (machines.verification); largest deviation +25.3 N m at 90 deg, rms 13.3 N m
label: torque vs published FEA (Yang et al. 2013)

name: zero_mean_torque_at_180deg_symmetry
detail: pure negative d-axis current on a rotor symmetric about its d-axis gives no mean torque

name: fem_vs_magnetised_ring_closed_form
detail: Magnetised ring, sector mesher + P1 FEM, pass/fail and tolerance of machines.verification; 8 sector copies, magnet edges on mesh edges

name: geometry_slot_and_magnet_areas_exact
detail: Machine sector geometry (Prius slot and magnet areas), pass/fail and tolerance of machines.verification; magnet area (straight edges) exact to 4.4e-16

name: maxwell_stress_vs_coenergy_torque
detail: Prius IPM: Maxwell stress vs co-energy torque, pass/fail and tolerance of machines.verification; max relative difference over the angles

name: dq_power_balance
detail: Prius IPM: dq power balance and frozen permeability, pass/fail and tolerance of machines.verification; frozen-permeability superposition error 4.1e-11; L_d = 1.386 mH, L_q = 2.420 mH, psi_pm = 0.2140 Wb at this point

name: mesh_convergence_peak_torque
detail: Prius IPM: mesh convergence of the peak torque, pass/fail and tolerance of machines.verification; 480: 343.42 N m, 960: 345.65 N m, 1920: 344.22 N m; difference ratio 1.56

name: torque_vs_getdp_second_code
detail: gmsh 4.12 + GetDP 3.2, 13 current angles: its own mesh, Newton solver and Arkkio torque, but the same geometry, materials and currents, so partly independent (it cannot catch an input error); tolerance 1 % of the peak

name: back_emf_vs_getdp_second_code
detail: fundamental at 1000 rpm, 60 positions; same sharing as the torque

name: cogging_linear_iron_vs_getdp
detail: with linear iron the two codes agree on cogging; with saturated bridges they converge 25 % apart (a declared uncertainty, not settled without a measurement or a third code)

name: skew_back_emf_vs_closed_form_factor
detail: every harmonic = straight harmonic x |sin(K h pi s / lam) / (K sin(h pi s / lam))|; checks the multi-slice composition, not the 2-D field

name: half_pitch_skew_lowers_cogging
detail: 2 steps over half a slot pitch: 1.353 -> 0.624 N m
